text:
The interview room was suffocatingly quiet, save for the relentless, rhythmic ticking of the clock on the wall. Each second felt like a hammer blow against my nerves. I sat there, paralyzed by the weight of this moment. This wasn't just another job application; it was my last lifeline. If I failed here, I would have no second chances to prove my worth or establish myself in this industry. The pressure was immense, and the silence amplified my fear that this might be the end of my career.

There are 365 days in a typical year.
